commit.what: Ref demo review fixes: read through the Ref, show its own stored data, fix mobile width

log: Review fixes landed, commit 44ca3f5e0. Fix 1: found and fixed a real bug while wiring RefView in — same-file resolve() settles so fast that RefView's own 'target' event fired before the page's DOM was attached to document, so its redraw() bail-and-unsubscribe-if-disconnected check fired once and the row stuck on '… a.shared' forever. Fixed by `await ref.resolve()` at module top level (before Page/content build), so RefView's first draw already has the real target — no RefView.js change needed. Proven headless: initial draw shows the real title through the Ref icon, and clicking Edit updates both List A and the Ref row. Fix 2: List B now shows {type, ...data} from ref.toJSON() under 'what List B actually stores'. Fix 3: flex.auto (not flex.wrap) makes the two cards fill the row and go full width on a phone; both pre blocks get inline white-space:pre-wrap so code wraps inside its card instead of overflowing — no new CSS classes. Re-shot 400/1200 (looked at both: full-width single column at 400, two columns at 1200, nothing clipped). smoke.mjs on /live/demos/ref/ and /files/: all ok. List.test.mjs still 47/47.

findings.text: A stale comment in the module this diff changes: `List.js` `ref()`'s block comment (worktree qf-1, `core/List/List.js:319-323`) still says `ref()` links "instead of re-parenting it the way `add(x)` still does (D13, 2026-11-02: switching `add()`'s own default is a later, separate merge…)". That stopped being true in this same diff. A fresh agent reading the code would believe `add()` still moves an item. One line fixes it: "`add(x)` now does the same (2026-11-09); `ref()` is the explicit form."

Demo ask 3 ("a small line naming where it really lives: Ref → list A / item id") is met only as raw JSON. List B shows `{"type":"Ref","path":"a.shared"}` under "what List B actually stores:" (shots/…/400.png, List B card). That proves what is stored, but a new coder has to decode `a.shared` themselves. Add a plain line such as "Ref → list a / item shared" above the JSON.

`public/live/demos/ref/files.jsonl` lists `shots/`, but the repo's `.gitignore:213` (`**/shots/`) ignores that folder. So the 400 and 1200 shots the brief asked for are on disk in the worktree but in no commit, and on a clone the listed file entry points at nothing. Either drop the `shots/` line, or accept it as the repo's convention for every demo.

`/live/demos/` (`public/live/demos/page.jsonl`) only has `{"file":"ref/"}` lines. Every other demo there has a `part-link` card (for example `codecard1`), and this one has none. The brief keeps the `/live/` link for the mastermind, so this is a reminder to add the card on `/live/demos/` too. Until then the demo is only reachable from the two doc links.

The guard in `List.add` is `x.parent && this.index_of(x) === -1`. That is broader than the brief's wording ("a parent that is a List other than this"). An item held in a slot (`adopt_slot`), not in any list, now also becomes a Ref when added to a list. The census found no such caller, and a Ref is the safe result, so this is recorded as a note only.
At 1200 and wider, the h3 "List A — owns the item" wraps to 2 lines (layout.json `wraps` at 1200/1920/3440), while the List B heading fits on 1. So the two cards' headings don't line up.
The intro paragraph shouts with capitals ("BOTH", "THROUGH"). Bold or plain words would read calmer (content: tone).
